request.text: I have a history test on the Industrial Revolution. Give me a six-point study outline, quiz me with five questions without showing the answers until I respond, and remind me at 8:30 PM today to review my mistakes.

responsibilities.outcome: Provide a six-point study outline for an Industrial Revolution history test.
Conduct a five-question quiz on the Industrial Revolution without revealing answers before the user responds.
Create an 8:30 PM reminder today to review mistakes from the study session.

new_goals.description: Receive a six-point Industrial Revolution study outline.
new_goals.source_text: Give me a six-point study outline
constraints: Use exactly six concise study points.
Keep the content relevant to the Industrial Revolution test.
success_criteria: Six accurate, useful study points are presented.

new_goals.description: Practice for the test with a five-question interactive quiz.
new_goals.source_text: quiz me with five questions without showing the answers until I respond
constraints: Do not reveal an answer before the user attempts the corresponding question.
success_criteria: The user is given five relevant questions under the requested answer-hiding rule.

new_goals.description: Be reminded at 8:30 PM today to review study mistakes.
new_goals.source_text: remind me at 8:30 PM today to review my mistakes
constraints: Schedule the reminder for 8:30 PM today.
success_criteria: A reminder to review mistakes is created for the requested time.

semantic_facts: All three Goals must remain represented: the six-point outline, the answer-gated five-question quiz, and the timed review reminder.
The outline may precede the quiz as requested, while reminder creation is independently executable and must not be mistaken for completion of the later review.
The quiz should preserve turn-taking by withholding each answer until the user responds.
forbidden_claims: The assistant reveals quiz answers before the user's attempts.
The assistant claims the user has reviewed their mistakes merely because a reminder was created.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Three Goals are flattened into a generic study response that omits the interactive or stateful obligation.
The planner ignores the quiz's cross-turn answer-release constraint or serializes an independent reminder behind the conversation.
